I replied to Hollis in our DM confirming that Gate 40 is now the dock for their Marrow Agrisupply pickups.

The note lives in that DM thread, where Hollis can see it. I didn't save it to my long-term memory: this is a one-off run, and that memory is meant for facts that apply to every conversation. I told Hollis I'd keep it between us unless they ask me to share it, so it won't go into other members' conversations or into channels. Nothing else was needed.
